# `InvalidPermissionMapException`

`Rasuvaeff\Yii3McpRbacBridge\Exception\InvalidPermissionMapException`

**Class** — [`Rasuvaeff\Yii3McpRbacBridge`](/packages/rbac-bridge) — [Source](https://github.com/rasuvaeff/yii3-mcp-rbac-bridge/blob/master/src/Exception/InvalidPermissionMapException.php) — **Extends:** `InvalidArgumentException`

A permission map that cannot be what the author meant: empty names, an
unknown tool class, or #[RequiredPermission] on a method that is not a
tool (fail-fast — a silently unenforced permission is a security bug).

No public properties or methods beyond the constructor.
